answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Consistency Rule: each identity must keep its interaction graph stable across a voyage of epochs, with a per-epoch persistence score. An identity whose score falls to a nadir below threshold across two consecutive epochs is throttled and its rewards frozen. The rule yields a crystal signal: genuine agents persist, while an attacker must fund and sustain each synthetic identity through multiple full epochs, paying continuous compute and upkeep per identity before earning anything.
